components:

      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:

          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp

          format: date-time

## Summary

Implemented the per-city `customerCode` for newly created owners, following the existing `membershipNumber` pattern in this codebase.

**Changes:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `customerCode` string field to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` (rebuilt at compile time) carries it.

2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — Added a static `customerCode(Owner, Collection<Owner>)` helper and ignored the field in `toOwnerDto` mapping. It formats `"<UPPERCASE_CITY>-<NNNN>"` where NNNN is the count of owners in the same city (case-insensitive) whose id is ≤ this owner's id, zero-padded to four digits. Since a new owner always has the largest id, this equals "one more than the number already in that city" at creation and stays stable on later reads — mirroring how `membershipNumber` guarantees stability.

3. **`RespondWithOwnerCreated`, `RespondWithOwner`, `RespondWithOwnerUpdated`** — Set `customerCode` on the DTO alongside `membershipNumber`, so it appears both in the POST create response and when read back via GET/PUT (which the acceptance test relies on, since it fetches the owner after creating).

The new `Cp10Tests` (first owner in a fresh city → `CITY-0001`, second → `CITY-0002`) passes, and `Cp09Tests` plus the entire suite remain green.
